disbursementAnnounced.detail: ₹9,00,000 per deceased (₹4L ex-gratia, post-mortem requirement waived + ₹5L CMRF top-up)
₹15,000 each to over 1,00,000 severely flood-affected families for essential needs
₹2,500 special instalment (up from the usual ₹1,250) for beneficiaries in Charaideo, Jorhat, Golaghat and Sivasagar, resuming 1 Aug 2026
Book grants ₹1,000 (Higher Secondary) to ₹5,000 (Post-Graduate); free duplicate mark sheets/certificates, no fee charged by schools, colleges, universities or SEBA

disbursementGapNote: These are announced policy commitments, not an audited spend report. The CM Relief Fund's own beneficiary-info page states funds are utilised "at the discretion of the Chief Minister" — there's no requirement for a public, itemised account of how the ₹26.58 Cr collected breaks down against these schemes, or what portion has actually reached people versus what's still pending disbursement.

rtiInfo.note: Official Assam state RTI portal. You can file a request to the Revenue & Disaster Management Department for an itemised CMRF spend report — ₹10 fee, 30-day statutory response window.

scamWarnings.warning: There have been confirmed reports of fake donation accounts and social media relief-fraud schemes exploiting the 2026 Assam floods.
